# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them through this repository's private [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/plasma-shot-inspector/security/advisories/new) page. Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and its potential impact. Avoid including credentials or other people's private data in the report.

The maintainers will review reports as their availability allows and coordinate any follow-up privately. Response and resolution times depend on the report's severity and the maintainers' availability.
